question: Who became the first Indian woman to be nominated as a member of the International Olympic Committee (IOC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nita Ambani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The headquarters of the International Olympic Committee is in Lausanne, Switzerland.

 
 
• The IOC headquarters have been in Lausanne, on the shores of Lake Geneva, since 1915.
 
• It was Pierre de Coubertin who chose this city.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• International Olympic Committee

 
 
• ​The International Olympic Committee is the guardian of the Olympic Games and the leader of the Olympic Movement.
 
• It is committed to promoting sports in society, strengthening the integrity of sports and supporting clean athletes and other sports organisations.
 
• The IOC organizes the modern Olympic Games and Youth Olympic Games (YOG), held in summer and winter, every four years.
 
• The current president of the IOC is Thomas Bach.​ 
 
 
 
• The three values of Olympism are excellence, friendship and respect.
 
 
• They constitute the foundation on which the Olympic Movement builds its activities to promote sport, culture and education with a view to building a better world.
